title: Wack 100 Didn't Think Game & Kanye West Would Let Him Release"MY LIFE WAS NEVER EAZY"
htmlContent:
Kanye West and The Game are getting ready to drop a new single called "MY LIFE WAS NEVER EAZY."

The single is scheduled to drop on Friday. The snippet that was dropped features lyrics aimed at estranged wife Kim Kardashian's new boyfriend, Pete Davidson, who Kardashian has seen since last October.

"God saved me from that crash/ just so I can beat Pete Davidson's ass." West references his car accident that took place back in 2002, which he was able to walk away from the incident.

One Friday afternoon, The Game's manager Wack 100 was on the Clubhouse in the Blood Room.

Wack was asked to share some insight on the single "MY LIFE WAS NEVER EAZY."

"That s*** disrespectful, my n***," said Wack. That cover is lightweight that s*** disrespectful. For those in LA, it will premiere at six o'clock on 92.3, and the link will be live on Spotify at 9 pm PST. Many of y'all don't realize that Game and Kanye were on that [XXL] Freshmen Cover together. So, they n**** went back there, I didn't think they were going to let me release it, but Kanye is back."

He added that he released the single independently. "The label was playing. Motherf**** was playing games, they thought I was playing s*** they called me two or three hours ago... They gotta stop thinking they can tell the artists when the music can come out."

During the conversation, Wack also talked about working with West over the last three to four months. Per Wack, they have been on nine different jets together.

"He comes to my crib, and I go to his crib; there's a lot of s*** that we are doing. The recent picture that Wack dropped on his Instagram was a business meeting.

"That picture with Will.I.Am was a meeting. You can't get those types of n**** together. You have to finesse that everybody is too busy.

Make sure you check out Kanye West and The Game's new single "MY LIFE WAS NEVER EAZY" on Spotify and other streaming platforms at 12 AM EST.
